label: Rétro

provenance.incarnation: Hal Emmerich/Otacon original MGS2 Philanthropy incarnation,2007/2009; dark tousled hair/glasses, full wrist sleeve ivory coat, green crewneck shirt, gray-violet trousers/black shoes, silver briefcase in right hand. Unarmed native Rétro gameplay adaptation; no MGS4 fusion.
